environment.description: Selects the package imported by generated JavaScript runtime modules: react-native-nitro-modules for react-native, or nitro-core for bare.

cxxNamespace.description: Represents the C++ namespace of the module that will be generated. This can have multiple sub-namespaces, and is always relative to `margelo::nitro`.

appleModuleName.description: Represents the Apple module name of the module that will be generated. It names the generated Swift module and SwiftPM library product. Use the same name in the library's `swiftpmConfig` in package.json.

apple.description: Required: Apple configuration, for iOS, macOS, tvOS and visionOS

androidNamespace.description: Represents the Android namespace ('package') of the module that will be generated. This can have multiple sub-namespaces, and is always relative to `com.margelo.nitro`.

androidCxxLibName.description: Represents the name of the Android C++ library (aka name in CMakeLists.txt `add_library(..)`). This will be loaded via `System.loadLibrary(...)`.

ignorePaths.description: A list of paths relative to the project directory that should be ignored by nitrogen. Nitrogen will not look for `.nitro.ts` files in these directories.

autolinking.description: Removed. Autolinking moved to `.nitro.ts`: declare an `implementation` in each platform decorator and a public constructor to enable `new`.
